title: Design Challenge

items: Pencils, markers and coloured pencils for each team

items.title: Sketch alone
items.text: Each student sketches one idea, without talking.

items.title: Share ideas
items.text: Each student shows their sketch; teammates name one idea to keep.

items.title: Design together
items.text: The team draws ONE cupcake on its worksheet and labels three teamwork qualities.
An idea, not a finished drawing. Give a one-minute warning.
About a minute each, or the first speaker uses up the slot.
Build one cupcake from parts: the base from one sketch, the frosting from another.
